productMeta.note: V47: durable feed inventory + checkpoints + continuation ledger; presentation budget rotates and is not an API source cap.

continuationLedger.note: Continuation proof across durable checkpoints. Declared feed metadata counts are not loaded products. Presentation budget ≠ API source cap.

productProgressLedger.note: withFeedTracked = inventory hasFeed only. productProgress excludes 1→1/0→0 and empty-API completePass bumps. Cursor advance without rows is CURSOR_ADVANCED, not product progress.

identityReconcile.note: Proposed remove/add is window ledger, not LIVE unpublish/publish. LKG carries NOT_YET_SEEN; growth budget caps NEW public identities.

shrinkageGate.note: Incomplete discovery must merge LKG or stay under drop thresholds before LIVE promote. OOS remediation drops are excluded from the ordinary budget.

lkgGrowthGate.note: Catalog may retain NOT_YET_SEEN via PUBLICATION_HOLD; public-eligible growth uses maxGrowthAbs/ratio only.
